title: The power of Prompts: Evaluating and Mitigating Gender Bias in MT with LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating translation accuracy of gendered terms and coreference resolution using specialized datasets (WinoMT, Gold BUG, MuST-SHE) by calculating Gender Accuracy, F1-male/female scores, and performance differences across pro- and anti-stereotypical sets.
